 Centre raises windfall tax on diesel and ATF while keeping petrol tax unchanged from November 16
 In a significant adjustment, the Centre has increased the windfall tax on diesel and aviation turbine fuel as of November 16. The new diesel duty stands at ₹14 per litre, up from ₹11.50, while the aviation turbine fuel levy rises to ₹12.50 per litre from ₹11.

 These updates were communicated through two notifications issued by the central board of indirect taxes and customs. The Centre has raised the windfall tax on diesel and aviation turbine fuel ( ATF ), while leaving the levy on petrol unchanged, in its latest fortnight revision effective November 16.
In two notifications issued on Monday, the central board of Indirect taxes and Customs (CBIC)revised the applicable duty to ₹14 per litre for diesel from earlier ₹11.50 per liter and ₹12.50 per litre for ATF from earlier ₹11 per litre. The petrol levy remains unchanged under the amendments.
